issue.title: Record the accepted Bob command-tree policy as a decision
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-46.3 note #5; explicitly deferred in plan:202610/bob_command_tree.md. cli_rules.md now records the behavior, but the decisions web has no command-tree record explaining the accepted choices and rejected alternatives. Propose decisions/command-tree-policy.md describing sectioned root help over broader nesting, the narrow vault-wide-task-writer rule, permanent silent byte-identical aliases, and frozen capture-* protocol siblings. Name the rejected broad bob task, capture-api, bob vault, and deprecation-hint alternatives. Read and cite the command-tree research and approved plan; retain only reasons those sources actually support and ask Bryan where reason evidence is missing. Obtain explicit memory authorization before writing, follow accepted-record immutability policy, then run sase memory init. This is a bounded single missing record, not a new architecture decision.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Propose a decisions-web record for the accepted sectioned-help/narrow-task/permanent-silent-alias/frozen-capture-protocol policy, citing research:202610/bob_cli_command_tree_reorganization/bob_cli_command_tree_reorganization.md and plan:202610/bob_command_tree.md; seek explicit memory authorization before writing and republish with sase memory init.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-46.3 note #5 asks for a durable decision record after the command-tree rollout. The epic authorized updating cli_rules.md but only filing this separate proposed decision; no memory edit is made during landing.
